title: Run unpowered native suppliers at smaller ranks and give an explicit signed-multiplier clock
body:
The complete signed multiplier can use both native words at their original depths. With the strongest submitted conditional κ of **0.0038901152865907**, the last binary rank drops from $2^{7168000000000000}$ to $2^{1050000000000000}$ and the numerical rank from $2^{1600000}$ to $2^{36000}$. The sufficient complete activation exponent drops from 7,645,866,239,991,957 to 1,095,879,152,647,278. A tape-transition calculation now gives an explicit recurring coefficient on every input length. [Proof of the retimed construction](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3d33cb0c8a523b66d91e8de8250b85d0a436eb35/research/retimed-native-multiplier/TRANSFER.md) · [Complete clock](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3d33cb0c8a523b66d91e8de8250b85d0a436eb35/research/retimed-native-multiplier/CLOCK.md) · [Exact results and refits](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3d33cb0c8a523b66d91e8de8250b85d0a436eb35/research/retimed-native-multiplier/RESULT.json)

| Complete installation | κ | Last binary rank exponent | Numerical exponent | Fixed setup exponent ≤ | Activation exponent | Recurring exponent ≤ |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Published strongest signed profile | .0038901152865907 | 7,168,000,000,000,000 | 1,600,000 | 7,340,032,000,000,000,003 | 7,645,866,239,991,957 | 125,269,872,000,160,591,302 |
| Retimed matched | .0038901152865907 | 1,050,000,000,000,000 | 36,000 | 513 | 1,095,879,152,647,278 | 17,954,883,993,607,921,665 |
| Retimed compact | .00387992803556 | 380,000 | 13,000 | 513 | 426,495 | 6,769,453,650 |
| Retimed small | .0038 | 48,000 | 3,000 | 513 | 51,471 | 787,093,646 |

For activation exponent A the sufficient signed input length is $2^{\lceil 2^A/6\rceil-1}+1$ bits. Fixed setup is at most $2^{513}$ transitions. With recurring exponent E, the total time is at most $2^{513}+2^E n(1+\log_2 n)^{1-\kappa}$ for every canonical input of at least one bit. The predecessor recurring numbers are a new explicit repricing in the same tape units. At the intermediate rate .00389011528 an actual refit of the older compiler activates at 3,615,709,999,957, compared with 644,320,117,023 here. This is a 5.61-fold reduction in the exponent. The earlier [PR #8040](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8040) had already cut fixed setup to exponents 4,098–6,267 using the powered words. [Cost of installation and actual cohorts](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3d33cb0c8a523b66d91e8de8250b85d0a436eb35/research/retimed-native-multiplier/INSTALLATION.md) · [Historical tapes and connected activation](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3d33cb0c8a523b66d91e8de8250b85d0a436eb35/research/retimed-native-multiplier/ACTIVATION.md) · [Comparable old settings](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3d33cb0c8a523b66d91e8de8250b85d0a436eb35/research/retimed-native-multiplier/equal_rate.py)

The implementation generates the physical raw roles, exact rational grade couplings, eight-coordinate binary chart programs and full signed Clifford atlas. A timed loan joins independently suspended raw calls of different sizes and paid ordinals. Its parent resumes only after the true owner returns. Source periods, zero padding, high coordinates, movement, restoration and all growing control are paid. The two positive directions, subject to the original numerical and analytic premises, still give the original integer rounding and carry. The construction retains the five inherited premises covering the physical all-column word, typed erasure, uniform transfer, precision and tape accounting, and analytic recovery. Independent scientific acceptance remains open. [Live scheduler](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3d33cb0c8a523b66d91e8de8250b85d0a436eb35/research/retimed-native-multiplier/transport.py) · [Source integration](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3d33cb0c8a523b66d91e8de8250b85d0a436eb35/research/retimed-native-multiplier/machine.patch) · [Numerical bound](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3d33cb0c8a523b66d91e8de8250b85d0a436eb35/research/retimed-native-multiplier/NUMERICAL.md)

With CPython 3.12, assertions enabled and Git on PATH, run

```sh
python3.12 -IB scripts/research_package.py --package research/retimed-native-multiplier
```

Expected final line

```text
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/retimed-native-multiplier outcome=completed
```

The complete local registered replay passed. It generated the production installations and verified both actual raw emitters, 4,096 independent fields with 2,958,336 singleton operations, real weighted shuttles, and the signed finite Fourier product −345550037539 including all five recovered coefficients. The public tiny-input path has its separate scalar stop. Four Lean modules built with Lean 4.34.1 and passed independent kernel replay. Their combined axioms are `propext`, `Classical.choice` and `Quot.sound`. The complete tape lowering and signed recovery remain written arguments. Production-scale payloads exceed available hardware. No empirical crossover is known. [Verification and formal coverage](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3d33cb0c8a523b66d91e8de8250b85d0a436eb35/research/retimed-native-multiplier/VERIFICATION.md) · [Registered replay](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3d33cb0c8a523b66d91e8de8250b85d0a436eb35/research/retimed-native-multiplier/verify.py)

Canonical main is `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. Ali Romman’s [PR #8027](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8027) supplies the paired words and their prior credits. His [PR #8030](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8030) supplies the physical caller and geometry at `6285dd829114705862e8d91facaedc1f31d3cfcb`. Clear1nsight’s [PR #8033](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8033) supplied the tilted tariff and [PR #8035](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8035) the signed-margin extension and portable sources at `ea776471bf8ed143a0625cf2d7532f65d15eb5f9`. The exact existing CI prerequisite `0618e75a22cec54d1651394ef83d088551b7f026` comes from the [PR #7257](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7257) historical verification repair. Ali Romman prepared this work with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.
